# People and segments

People are the authors behind the mentions, with their accounts, reach, tags, notes and outreach (owner, stage, last contacted). Sort by `reach`, `new`, `mentions` or `recent`. Muting hides a person's posts from the feed and every channel; billing never changes. The first logged activity claims an unowned person; it never takes a person from their owner. Segments are saved people filters. Confirm with the user before merging people.

Base URL `https://api.rumoro.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $RUMORO_API_KEY` with each request, JSON in and out. Each endpoint names its `rumoro` CLI command for when the CLI is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Endpoints

### Export people as CSV (`GET /v1/people/export.csv`)

Returns as CSV the people GET /v1/people lists for the same filters, segmentId included. Each row is one person with handle, followers, email, website, company, location and tags, then outreach stage, owner and last contacted. The file holds at most 5,000 people. Each workspace can export 6 times a minute, and a 429 includes Retry-After.

CLI command `rumoro people:export`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `platform` | query | `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Only people with a profile on this platform. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Searches the display name, handle and profile link, ignoring case. |
| `handle` | query | string |  | Looks up a person by one of their accounts, given as a handle (@sam, u/sam, sam) or a profile or post link (https://x.com/sam). The match is exact but ignores case, and covers merged accounts. Add platform to pick one platform. A link already tells which platform it is. |
| `tag` | query | string |  | Keeps people with this tag, matched exactly and by case. |
| `muted` | query | boolean |  | true keeps muted people and false people who are not muted. Leave it out for everyone. |
| `since` | query | string |  | A time in ISO 8601 or epoch ms. Keeps people first matched then or later. |
| `segmentId` | query | string |  | Adds a saved segment's filter to all other filters here. An unknown id returns 404. |
| `platforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Keeps people who have an account on one of these platforms. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `tags` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps people with one of these tags. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `minFollowers` | query | integer or null |  | This many followers or more. People with an unknown count are left out. |
| `maxFollowers` | query | integer or null |  | Keeps people with this many followers or fewer. |
| `minMentions` | query | integer |  | Minimum number of matched mentions. |
| `minNegative` | query | integer |  | Minimum number of negative mentions. |
| `intents` | query | string[] or null |  | Has a mention tagged with one of these intents. |
| `notPlatforms` | query | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Leaves out people with an account on these platforms. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `notTags` | query | string[] or null |  | Leaves out people with one of these tags. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `notIntents` | query | string[] or null |  | Leaves out people whose mentions have one of these intents. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `keywordKinds` | query | list of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic` |  | Only people with a mention of these keyword kinds. |
| `neverKeywordKinds` | query | list of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic` |  | Excludes people who mentioned these keyword kinds. |
| `newSinceDays` | query | integer |  | People first seen in the past this many days. |
| `linkHosts` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps people with a mention that links to one of these hosts or its subdomains. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `stages` | query | list of `not_contacted`, `contacted`, `replied`, `in_talks`, `customer`, `not_a_fit` |  | Keeps people at one of these outreach stages. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `automated` | query | boolean |  | true keeps people whose matched posts are mostly machine-made, such as bots. false keeps the others. Leave it out for everyone. |
| `ownerIds` | query | string[] or null |  | Keeps people owned by one of these members, by user id. Use `none` for people without an owner. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas. |
| `sort` | query | `mentions`, `recent`, `reach`, `new` |  | mentions puts the most matches first. recent puts the most recently seen first. reach puts the most followers first, with unknown counts at the end. new puts people seen for the first time most recently first. |

Answers `200` (A UTF-8 CSV file).

### List people (`GET /v1/people`)

Returns the authors of your mentions, one row per person. Each row has their accounts, reach, public profile, stats for this workspace, your notes and tags, and your outreach status. You can filter by platform, tag, follower range, mention counts, intents, keyword kinds they did or did not mention, outreach stage, owner, automated (bots whose matched posts are mostly machine-made) or a saved segment. Pages use offset and include a total.

### Get a person (`GET /v1/people/{id}`)

Fetches a person, with your workspace's own data on them. The id of a merged account returns the person it was merged into.

CLI command `rumoro people:get`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The person's id (aut_...). |

Answers `200` with `id`, `platform`, `name`, `handle`, `url`, `avatarUrl`, `accounts`, `reach`, `profile`, `stats`, `annotations`, `outreach` (the requested person).

### Update a person (`PATCH /v1/people/{id}`)

Changes your workspace's tags, notes and mute for the person, and the outreach owner and stage. The owner must be a workspace member, and null removes it. Muting hides their posts from your feed and all channels. Collection and billing do not change.

CLI command `rumoro people:update`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The person's id (aut_...). |

JSON body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tags` | string[] |  | Sets the full new list. |
| `notes` | string |  |  |
| `muted` | boolean |  |  |
| `ownerId` | string or null |  | The user id of the member responsible for this contact. Null removes it. |
| `stage` | `not_contacted`, `contacted`, `replied`, `in_talks`, `customer`, `not_a_fit` |  | The outreach stage your team has reached with this person. |

Answers `200` with `id`, `platform`, `name`, `handle`, `url`, `avatarUrl`, `accounts`, `reach`, `profile`, `stats`, `annotations`, `outreach` (the person after the change).

### Merge people (`POST /v1/people/{id}/merge`)

Marks this account and another person as the same individual, in your workspace only. The person in `into` receives the mentions, tags, notes and outreach activities, and keeps its owner and stage, taking the other's where it has none.

CLI command `rumoro people:merge`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The person's id (aut_...). |

JSON body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `into` | string | yes | The id of the person to merge this account into. |

Answers `200` with `id`, `platform`, `name`, `handle`, `url`, `avatarUrl`, `accounts`, `reach`, `profile`, `stats`, `annotations`, `outreach` (the person who now has this account).

### Split a person (`POST /v1/people/{id}/split`)

Reverses a merge, so the account is a separate person again.

CLI command `rumoro people:split`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The person's id (aut_...). |

Answers `200` with `id`, `platform`, `name`, `handle`, `url`, `avatarUrl`, `accounts`, `reach`, `profile`, `stats`, `annotations`, `outreach` (the account as a separate person).

### List outreach activities (`GET /v1/people/{id}/activities`)

Returns up to 200 logged contacts with this person over all their accounts, latest first. Each shows who reached out, the channel, the time and a short note. Check it before you reach out, so two teammates don't contact the same person unaware.

CLI command `rumoro people:activities`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The person's id (aut_...). |

Answers `200` with `data` (the person's logged activities).

### Log outreach (`POST /v1/people/{id}/activities`)

Logs a contact with this person, such as an email, a direct message or a call. A not_contacted person moves to contacted. A person with no owner gets the contacting member as owner. A later stage or an existing owner is left alone. `memberId` falls back to the signed-in member. An API-key request without memberId logs an activity with no member, so no owner is set.

CLI command `rumoro people:log-activity`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The person's id (aut_...). |

JSON body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `channel` | `email`, `x`, `linkedin`, `bluesky`, `reddit`, `github`, `call`, `meeting`, `other` | yes | How the person was contacted. |
| `note` | string |  | A short summary of what was sent or said. |
| `occurredAt` | string |  | Defaults to now. Otherwise send the contact time as ISO 8601 or epoch ms. |
| `memberId` | string |  | The user id of the member who reached out. Defaults to the signed-in member. With an API key and no value, the activity has no member. |

Answers `201` with `id`, `personId`, `channel`, `note`, `member`, `occurredAt`, `createdAt` (the new activity).

### Delete outreach (`DELETE /v1/people/{id}/activities/{activityId}`)

Deletes an activity that was logged by mistake. The person keeps the same owner and stage.

CLI command `rumoro people:delete-activity`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The person's id (aut_...). |
| `activityId` | path | string | yes | The activity's id (act_...). |

Answers `204` (done).

### List segments (`GET /v1/segments`)

Returns your saved segments with the current number of people in each, plus presets you can save as a start. Segments are counted on each read and never stored as lists. To see who is in one, send its id to GET /v1/people.

CLI command `rumoro segments:list`

Answers `200` with `data`, `presets` (all segments and the presets).

### Create a segment (`POST /v1/segments`)

Saves a people filter under a name. Names are unique in the workspace (409). The response says how many people match now.

CLI command `rumoro segments:create`

JSON body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `filter` | object |  |  |
| `filter.platforms` | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Only people with a profile on one of these platforms. |
| `filter.tags` | string[] |  | People with one of these tags. |
| `filter.minFollowers` | integer |  | This many followers or more. People with an unknown count are left out. |
| `filter.maxFollowers` | integer |  | This many followers or fewer. People with an unknown count are left out. |
| `filter.minMentions` | integer |  | Minimum number of matched mentions. |
| `filter.minNegative` | integer |  | Minimum number of negative mentions. |
| `filter.intents` | string[] |  | Has a mention tagged with one of these intents. |
| `filter.keywordKinds` | list of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic` |  | Only people with a mention of these keyword kinds. |
| `filter.neverKeywordKinds` | list of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic` |  | Excludes people who mentioned these keyword kinds. |
| `filter.notPlatforms` | list of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps` |  | Leaves out people who have an account on these platforms. |
| `filter.notTags` | string[] |  | Leaves out people with one of these tags. |
| `filter.notIntents` | string[] |  | Excludes people with a mention of these intents. |
| `filter.newSinceDays` | integer |  | People first seen in the past this many days. |
| `filter.linkHosts` | string[] |  | People with a mention that links to one of these hosts or its subdomains. |
| `filter.muted` | boolean |  | true keeps only muted people and false only people who are not muted. |
| `filter.stages` | list of `not_contacted`, `contacted`, `replied`, `in_talks`, `customer`, `not_a_fit` |  | Only people in one of these outreach stages. |
| `filter.automated` | boolean |  | true keeps people whose matched posts are mostly automated, like bots. false keeps the rest. |
| `filter.ownerIds` | string[] |  | People owned by one of these members, by user id. Use "none" for people without an owner. |

Answers `201` with `id`, `name`, `description`, `filter`, `count`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` (the new segment and how many people are in it).
